The answer rests on the literature on the real Jacobian conjecture in the plane. I recall that Braun and dos Santos Filho handled degrees up to 3, that Braun and Oréfice-Okamoto extended the injectivity result to $\deg p \le 4$, and that degree-5 counterexamples with a nowhere-vanishing Jacobian exist. I could not verify these citations and bounds against the sources here, so the confidence is moderate.

CONFIDENCE: 3
